sources.entry: DiskWarrior - The world’s most advanced repair and recovery tool for Mac.

summary.name: DiskWarrior
summary.one_liner: DiskWarrior is a Mac disk repair and data recovery utility that rebuilds damaged disk directories to recover files from HFS+ volumes.
use_cases: Recovering files when a Mac won't start up
Repairing an external hard disk that no longer appears
Fixing directory damage reported by Disk Utility
Copying files off a failing drive to a new drive
Checking drive health with SMART alerts
summary.what_it_does: DiskWarrior reads a damaged disk directory, finds salvageable files and folders, and builds a new error-free, optimized directory. It offers a preview of the repaired disk, and can compare the damaged and repaired states before changes are made. It verifies the rebuilt directory and swaps it in with a fail-safe method. It can use SMART technology to test and alert on impending drive failure, and can copy good files from a failing drive to a new one. It is sold with a DiskWarrior Recovery flash drive for booting the Mac.
notable: Patented preview of the repaired disk before any changes are made
Bundled DiskWarrior Recovery flash drive for booting when the Mac won't start
Free technical support from data recovery specialists, who can often recover data remotely
Supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs back to OS X Mountain Lion (10.8.5)
caveats: Apple File System (APFS) disks are not currently supported
Startup disks on SSDs from macOS High Sierra through Sequoia cannot be rebuilt because they are preloaded with APFS
Rebuilding external disks is required for newer macOS versions; internal SSD support is limited
Boot via Recovery HD and Internet Recovery is not supported on Apple Silicon
